# Contributing to NeoDoc

This repository is proprietary and maintained by NeoForge Labs.

## Rules

- All changes must be made via pull requests
- No direct commits to `main`
- CI must pass before merging
- Public APIs must not change without discussion
- Core must remain format-agnostic

## Branching

- `main`: stable
- `v1`: active development
- `feature/*`: short-lived feature work
